newsitem.title: USA: ECC SAYS NO LONGER ACTIVELY SEEKING A BUYER.
newsitem.headline: ECC SAYS NO LONGER ACTIVELY SEEKING A BUYER.

text.p: ECC International Corp said Monday it is no longer actively seeking a buyer for its business, but it is evaluating other business opportunities, including possible acquisitions or joint ventures.
ECC said it has been working with an investment banker, Oppenheimer & Co, on a possible sale of the company or of its vending division.
The company said it plans to continue working with Oppenheimer to evaluate other business opportunities.
ECC said shareholders voted at the annual meeting on December 3, 1996 to direct the board to retain an investment banker with the goal of enhancing shareholder values.
